title: [AI Post Maker][V1] MVP End-to-End Flow
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- Deliver the V1 MVP end-to-end flow described in agents.md with working generation, captioning, UI visibility, and manual sharing.

Scope:
- In scope: prompt submission, image generation lifecycle, caption generation, UI updates, manual sharing actions, and CI parity.
- Out of scope: scheduling, automation, Instagram API posting, billing, token usage, multi-provider optimization.

Acceptance Criteria:
- A signed-in user can submit a prompt, see status progress, receive an image + caption, and use manual share actions.
- Failures surface clearly in UI and do not leave stale states.
- CI workflows pass on main for lint and tests.

Technical Notes:
- Primary areas: app/controllers/home_controller.rb, app/jobs/*.rb, app/services/*.rb, app/components/**/*, app/javascript/controllers/*, config/routes.rb.

Tests:
- Controller/job/service tests updated or added per child tickets.
- Any UI refresh mechanisms covered by request/system tests where feasible.

Definition of Done:
- All child tickets completed and validated; CI green.

title: [AI Post Maker][V1][Caption] Integrate Gemini API for captions
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- Caption generation is currently a local stub and does not use Gemini, so V1 requirement "Caption generation via Gemini" is unmet.

Scope:
- In scope: implement real Gemini API call, parse response into variants, handle errors, and wire env config.
- Out of scope: multi-caption selection UI (V2), provider fallback (V2), billing or token usage (V3).

Acceptance Criteria:
- When GEMINI_API_KEY is configured, GenerateCaptionJob persists a Gemini-generated caption on the Post.
- Errors from Gemini are caught and stored in post.data["caption_error"] without crashing the job.
- README/.env.example document the required Gemini key and any model defaults.

Technical Notes:
- Update app/services/gemini_caption_service.rb to call Gemini API via Faraday.
- Add/adjust env keys in .env.example and README.md.
- Update tests: test/services/gemini_caption_service_test.rb, test/jobs/generate_caption_job_test.rb.

Tests:
- Service unit tests for success + error paths using Faraday test stubs (or equivalent).
- Job test ensures caption persists and errors are stored without raising.

Definition of Done:
- Gemini API integration merged, tests passing, and docs updated.
- Size: M.

title: [AI Post Maker][V1][Dashboard] Live job status refresh
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- Job status and caption/image completion are not reflected in the UI until manual refresh; poller controller exists but is unused.

Scope:
- In scope: add a turbo-stream endpoint to refresh the dashboard panel and wire the poller controller to call it.
- Out of scope: real-time websockets, multi-user activity feeds, analytics dashboards.

Acceptance Criteria:
- While a job is queued/processing, the right panel auto-refreshes and shows updated status, caption, and asset when ready.
- The poller is lightweight and only updates the dashboard frame.
- No manual refresh is required to see completion/failure.

Technical Notes:
- Add a route + controller action (e.g., HomeController#dashboard_jobs) that renders turbo_stream.replace("dashboard_jobs", Dashboard::RightPanelComponent).
- Wire data-controller="poller" and data-poller-url-value on the dashboard container (app/views/home/index.rb or component).
- Consider a small interval (e.g., 5s) and ensure it stops on disconnect.

Tests:
- Request/controller test for the new turbo-stream endpoint.
- Optional system test to assert the dashboard updates after job completion (if feasible).

Definition of Done:
- Dashboard auto-refresh is wired and verified; tests passing.
- Size: M.

title: [AI Post Maker][V1][Auth] Scope prompts/posts to current user
description:
Purpose / Problem:
- Prompts and posts are not tied to a user; any signed-in user can see/delete others' content.

Scope:
- In scope: add user ownership to prompts/posts/assets and scope queries and controllers to current_user.
- Out of scope: team accounts, sharing posts across users, admin dashboards.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Each prompt/post belongs to a user and is only visible/manageable by that user.
- Home dashboard lists only the current user's posts.
- Deleting a post does not affect other users' data.

Technical Notes:
- Add user_id to prompts (or posts) via migration; update associations in app/models/prompt.rb, app/models/post.rb, app/models/user.rb.
- Scope HomeController queries and PostsController lookups by current_user.
- Update fixtures and tests: test/fixtures/prompts.yml, test/fixtures/posts.yml, test/controllers/*.

Tests:
- Controller tests for scoping (home index and destroy/cancel only access owned records).
- Model association tests for user ownership.

Definition of Done:
- User data is isolated across the app; tests updated and passing.
- Size: L.

title: [AI Post Maker][V1][Caption] Surface caption errors in UI

Acceptance Criteria:

- Error display does not affect successful captions.

Technical Notes:
- Extend DashboardJob to expose caption_error.
- Update app/components/dashboard/* to render caption error state.
- Add i18n copy under config/locales/*.yml if needed.

Tests:

- View/component test if available, or controller test that renders error text.

Definition of Done:
- Caption errors are visible in UI and covered by tests.
- Size: S.
